hook: Your answer from space was Saare Jahan Se Accha.
title: India Seen From Space: Saare Jahan Se Accha
description:
In April 1984, Rakesh Sharma became the first Indian in space. Asked by Indira Gandhi how India looked from orbit, he answered with Saare Jahan Se Accha. The line means better than the whole world. Series: If You Were in Space.

#Shorts #RakeshSharma #Space
